en: Composed by Śrī Pa. Pa. Vāsudevānandasarasvatī Teṃbe Svāmī Mahārāja:
Oṃ, salutations to the Blessed Dattātreya, who is satisfied by mere remembrance, who wards off great fear, who bestows supreme knowledge, and whose nature is consciousness and bliss.
To the one who wears the guise of a child, a madman, and a piśāca; to the great yogin, the avadhūta;

to the son of Atri, who increases the bliss of Anasūyā; Oṃ, to the one who releases from the bonds of worldly existence; Āṃ, to the one who accomplishes the impossible; Hīṃ, to the giver of all prosperity.
*Krauṃ* for the attraction of the unattainable; *aiṃ* for the bestowal of speech; *klīṃ* for the subjugation of the three worlds;
*sauḥ* for the agitation of all minds; *śrīṃ* for the bestowal of great prosperity;
*glauṃ* for the bestowal of sovereignty over the circle of the earth; *drāṃ* for long life.
Vaṣaṭ! Subjugate, subjugate! Vauṣaṭ! Attract, attract!
Huṃ! Cause hatred, cause hatred! Phaṭ! Expel, expel!
Ṭhaḥ Ṭhaḥ! Paralyze, paralyze! Kheṃ Kheṃ! Kill, kill!

Homage to Saṃpannaya, to Saṃpannaya, svāhā! Nourish, nourish! Cut asunder, cut asunder the supreme mantras, supreme yantras, and the dependencies of others! Ward off, ward off the seizing spirits! Destroy, destroy the diseases!
Remove, remove suffering! Disperse, disperse poverty!
Nurture, nurture the body! Satisfy, satisfy the mind!
To you who are the very nature of all mantras, to you who are the very nature of all yantras!
To the one whose nature is all tantras, whose nature is all sprouts,
Oṃ, homage to the Great Siddha, svāhā!
